evidenceFlow.title: Repository metadata
evidenceFlow.detail: Repository URL, homepage, description, topics, and release tag were read from the public GitHub remote.

evidenceFlow.title: Pages deployment
evidenceFlow.detail: GitHub Pages API state was observed as built for all 74 releases during their respective release checks.

evidenceFlow.title: Live endpoint
evidenceFlow.detail: The root URLs returned HTTP 200 during the release run; UK Garage-Inspired was rechecked after its delayed deployment.

evidenceFlow.title: Release validation
evidenceFlow.detail: Each local release's validation report recorded PASS before its public release commit.

evidenceFlow.title: Motion previews
evidenceFlow.detail: All 74 product branches were checked against the new commits. Each 18-second MP4 and caption file was checked on Pages; the MP4 bytes matched its recorded SHA-256 before local working copies were removed. Checks are a dated snapshot, not continuous monitoring.

metricDefinitions.label: Published release
metricDefinitions.definition: One of the 74 session repositories with verified public GitHub source and Pages.

metricDefinitions.label: Validated MIDI exports
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of recorded MIDI exports, including validated focused clips in batches four and five.

rows.title: Human listening and producer QA
rows.why: Automated MIDI validation does not establish musical usefulness, mix readiness, or arrangement quality.
rows.evidence: All 74 preview audio files decoded; no sample peak measured at or above 0 dBFS and no mean level was below -50 dBFS. No human listening review was recorded.
rows.gate: Complete documented listening notes and a pass/fail decision per pack before commercial promotion.

rows.title: Rights and cultural-sensitivity review
rows.why: Public source and downloads do not prove commercial clearance or appropriate genre representation.
rows.evidence: No rights or cultural-authenticity clearance was recorded.
rows.gate: Approve final licensing terms, naming, and public commercial-use policy.

rows.title: Pack-specific visual polish
rows.why: Distinctive pack artwork and motion previews now exist. A human art-direction review can identify improvements for selected paid launches.
rows.evidence: All 74 motion previews are live; 33 earlier packs use their individually created dashboard artwork in the new video. No human art-direction signoff was recorded.
rows.gate: Approve unique cover/preview treatment for any pack selected for a paid launch.

rows.title: Storefront, licensing, and entitlement path
rows.why: There is no payment, license selection, fulfillment, or buyer-support path in the published pack Pages.
rows.evidence: No commerce or payment system was built in this session.
rows.gate: Choose merchant, price architecture, license terms, and customer delivery workflow before implementation.

rows.title: Curated bundle hub
rows.why: A single collection surface can connect the validated catalog to a commercial path once P0/P1 release gates are resolved.
rows.evidence: This dashboard is release control, not a sales or checkout surface.
rows.gate: Build only after commercial proposition, rights, and storefront decisions are approved.

source.sourceIdentity: release completion and unperformed review boundaries

evidenceFlow.title: Scope boundary
evidenceFlow.detail: Actions are ranked from recorded release evidence and explicit missing review steps, not predicted customer demand or revenue.
